title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E02 — Family Ties
In Family Ties, Judge Bean comes to the aid of the Peralta family as unscrupulous real estate agents try to force them off their land. They've learned that a railroad will need the property, and they intend to make an undeserved profit.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E12 — The Fugitive
Thieves posing as newspapermen attempt to blackmail a local rancher to steal his land and property.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E21 — The Hidden Truth
Judge Bean discovers that a young vagabond he jailed for a minor offense might be involved in a major unsolved gold heist.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E32 — The Hypnotist
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, a con involving the Haunted Hills draws Judge Roy's attention.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E09 — Judge Declares a Holiday
The judge meets up with a con man who comes to towns and arranges horse races; he then skips town with the receipts and all the money that was bet.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Judge's Dilemma
A gang plans to take over the town by getting Judge Bean to resign over false misconduct charges.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
The Katcina Doll
Shorts and Hurley hold a doll hostage that brings good luck to a Mexican village.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E13 — Letty Leaves Home
A couple of con men attempt to lure Letty into their scheme and get her to go to San Francisco.

title: Custer's Last Stand
description: The search for a missing medicine arrow sparks a series of Indian attacks. Feature version of the serial.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Ghost Town Gold
description: The Three Mesquiteers set out to trap outlaws who have robbed a bank and stashed the loot in an abandoned village.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) join a spooky search for a lost city of riches.

title: The Two-Gun Man
description: A cowboy (Ken Maynard) rousts rustlers and woos a blonde (Lucille Powers) on the range.

title: Springtime in the Sierras
description: A gang of poachers must be stopped as they kill and sell game out of season. Roy figures out who the culprits are and goes undercover to investigate further.

title: The Red Rope
description: Ranch hand Tom Shaw must face off against a nefarious gunslinger to save his lady love's ranch.

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E10 — The Will
A stage line driver is framed in the looting of strongboxes by the stage line owner and freighter.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E12 — Renegade Son
After a woman is wrongfully jailed, Cisco and Pancho plan to trap the real murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E15 — Lynching Story
Cisco and Pancho prove that an office manager and his followers are murderers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E16 — Newspaper Crusaders
A gambler's thugs beat up a crusading newspaperman.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E19 — Harry Tracy
Harry Tracy terrorized America's northwest at the end of the 19th century; Matt and a posse have cornered the outlaw.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E20 — The Wild Bunch of Wyoming
Matt and Frankie follow Butch Cassidy to South America.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E22 — Little Britches
A young woman meets an outlaw; Matt investigates a railroad holdup.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E21 — The Doolin Gang
Frankie poses as a gang member's wife but gets caught.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E15 — The Blood Line
An Easterner swears revenge for the death of his father, a drunk that a Cartwright killed in self-defense.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E21 — Spanish Grant
A former dance hall girl poses as a Spanish heiress to claim a land grant that includes part of the Ponderosa; guest Sebastian Cabot.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E22 — Blood on the Land
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Home in Oklahoma
description: A singing newsman (Roy Rogers), a ranch foreman (George "Gabby" Hayes) and a newswoman (Dale Evans) team up to track killers.

title: In Old Cheyenne
description: A singing reporter (Roy Rogers) and a framed man (George "Gabby" Hayes) put a town boss out of business.

title: Kentucky Rifle
description: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.

title: Buffalo Stampede
description: Buffalo hide trader Tom Doan must track down and outsmart a gang of white thieves disguised as raiding American Indians to save the woman he loves.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: The Outlaw
description: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).

title: Santa Fe Trail
description: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Born to Battle
description: Cattlemen offer a jailed cowboy his freedom if he will agree to help locate a gang of notorious rustlers.

title: Brothers of the West
description: Detective Tom Wade (Tom Tyler) has to investigate the truth behind a robbery and murder of a bank president that's being blamed on Tom's brother, Ed (Bob Terry), who is nowhere to be found.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E17 — Dog Story
A dog leads Cisco and Pancho to his murdered master's gold mine where they become trapped by the victim's killers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E18 — Confession for Money
Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E19 — The Old Bum
A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E20 — Haven for Heavies
Cisco and Pancho set out to prove that a notorious outlaw has murdered a U.S. marshal.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E23 — Black Jack Ketchum
An outlaw convinces the son of a former gang-member to join his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E24 — Tom Horn
Matt's old friend, Tom Horn, turns into an outlaw and starts a land war.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E25 — Ben Thompson
Matt and Frankie look into Ben Thompson's background; Matt gets a job at a gambling den to obtain evidence about Ben's criminal activities.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E26 — Clay Allison
Matt arrests John Allison; Frankie's doctor is kidnapped; Clay falls into Matt's trap.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E34 — The Truant
Hawkeye and Chingachgook escort young Greg to the boy's Aunt Emma and Uncle Mort; Greg inherits his parents' valuable mine which makes him a target.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E35 — The Royal Grant
Cressing claims to have a royal grant giving him ownership of the town.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E36 — The Long Rifles
Someone is selling illegal guns to the Indians and the townspeople blame gunsmith Eben Cotten.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E37 — The Printer
Freedom of the press is threatened when the editor is framed for murder.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E38 — The Indian Doll
Little Snowbird falls into a deep trance after Hawkeye presents her with a doll.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E39 — Circle of Hate
Ever since Lt. Smith joined Col. Courtney's command, unexplained Indian deaths have increased and threatens to ignite a war between the colonial forces and the Iroquois nation.

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E01 — Hawkeye's Homecoming
Hawkeye finds out that his brother has joined the British army and is now a "redcoat."

title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans
description:
S01 E02 — The Threat
Hawkeye and Chingachgook find a group of new settlers, trapped in the Huron's territory.

title: Grand Canyon Trail
description: Not long after ambitious prospector J. Malcolm Vanderpool takes an interest in the run-down remnants of a small frontier town, fortune seekers from all over rush to gain a silver mine of their own.

title: Colorado
description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them.

title: The Cowboy and the Prizefighter
description: Red Ryder KO's a fight racket with sidekick Little Beaver and a new friend.

title: Northwest Trail
description: A Mountie (Bob Steele) escorts a young woman bringing cash to her father in the wild.

title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
description: Hopalong Cassidy and his sidekicks lure outlaws out of Oklahoma to justice in Texas.

title: Range War
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.

title: The Light of Western Stars
description: A Boston socialite (Jo Ann Sayers) attracts a ruffian (Victor Jory) along the Mexican border circa 1915.

title: Vengeance Valley
description: A rancher's son (Robert Walker) gets his foster brother (Burt Lancaster) in trouble with an unwed mother's brothers.

title: Wagon Trail
description: Townsfolk turn against their sheriff (Harry Carey) because of his outlaw son (Edward Norris).

title: The Range Busters
description: The Range Busters (Ray Corrigan, John King, Max Terhune) make their cowboy-trio debut, hunting a phantom killer.

title: Gunsmoke Ranch
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Bob Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) stop a land swindler out to profit from a flood.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: Fast Bullets
description: Two Texas Rangers (Tom Tyler, Rex Lease) nab smugglers and rescue a woman (Margaret Nearing) from a runaway wagon.

title: Call of the Forest
description: A young boy's camaraderie with wild animals comes in handy when he sets out to avenge his father's death.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Bad Man of Deadwood
description: A cowboy (Roy Rogers) hides from his past in a fake professor's (George "Gabby" Hayes) medicine show and helps town outcasts fight civic reformers.

title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing.

title: Mohawk
description: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.

title: Captain Apache
description: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

title: The Hanged Man
description: A former gunslinger survives his own hanging and transforms himself into a mysterious avenger of injustice.

title: Rawhide
description: A baseball star (Lou Gehrig) goes west with his sister (Evalyn Knapp) and helps a lawyer (Smith Ballew) bust a cattle-protection racket.

title: Sagebrush Trail
description: A man is falsely imprisoned on a murder charge, then escapes to join an outlaw gang and unmask the real killer.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: The Star Packer
description: Marshal John Travers investigates the murder of a town's sheriff, makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down a bandit called the Shadow.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: Rage at Dawn
description: A special agent (Randolph Scott) poses as a train robber to infiltrate Frank Reno's (Forrest Tucker) outlaw gang.
